- [ ] Default guardrails are not weakened (human approval, no credential handling, low volume, risk brake). / 未削弱默认护栏（人工审批、不接触凭据、低频、风控刹车）。
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, or real account handles. / 不含机密、个人信息或真实账号。
